classification.difficultyReason: Choose an area decomposition for the L-shaped region, infer an unlabelled width by subtraction, form and solve a quadratic, and reject the root giving invalid lengths.

content.prompt: The shaded area is $206\text{ cm}^2$. What is the value of $x$?

spec.description: An L-shaped region with a full-width top edge and a lower-right rectangular notch. Labels remain attached to their source edges. Black outlines replace decorative red outlines; light red fill identifies the stated shaded area.
spec.mathematics: Outer rectangle dimensions are 4x−2 and 2x+5. The remaining bottom-left width is 2x, so the removed rectangle has width 2x−2 and height x+3. Diagram proportions are illustrative, with no additional numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: All four source dimensions and the shaded region are permanent student-visible givens; no calculated lengths or answers appear.

answer.worked:
The missing rectangle has width $(4x-2)-2x=2x-2$.

$$\begin{align*}
(4x-2)(2x+5)-(x+3)(2x-2)&=206\\
8x^2+16x-10-(2x^2+4x-6)&=206\\
6x^2+12x-210&=0\\
x^2+2x-35&=0
\end{align*}$$

Here $a=1$, $b=2$, $c=-35$.

$$\begin{align*}
x&=\frac{-2\pm\sqrt{2^2-4(1)(-35)}}{2(1)}\\
x&=\frac{-2\pm\sqrt{144}}{2}\\
x&=\frac{-2\pm12}{2}\\
x&=5\text{ or }-7
\end{align*}$$

Reject $x=-7$ because lengths must be positive. For $x=5$, the area is $18\times15-8\times8=206\text{ cm}^2$. Therefore $x=5$.
